message:
Confirmed. When `dwarfstring_append(&joind.js_linkstring, link_string_in)` is called with `link_string_in = ""` (empty string), `dwarfstring_append_length` returns early because `slen == 0`, so `js_linkstring.s_data` remains pointing to the global `""` literal.

Then in `_dwarf_pathjoinl`, `inputs = dwarfstring_string(input)` = `""` (global), and `is_full_path(inputs, joinchar)` reads `inputs[0]` (NUL) and `inputs[1]` (out-of-bounds read past the 1-byte global `""`).
